transcript:
User: Hi — I saw your ad on Facebook about answering missed calls. I keep losing patients after hours, so I'm curious how it works.
Agent: Got it — after-hours is where a lot of patients slip away. When your office is closed, where do those calls go right now—voicemail, answering service, or just ringing out?
User: Right now, the calls go straight to voicemail after hours. We get about 20 of those a week.
Agent: Yeah, that makes sense — voicemail after hours is where people tend to move on fast. When those 20 calls hit voicemail, do they usually leave a message, or do they hang up and call somewhere else?
User: Most hang up, and I worry they might call a competitor instead.
Agent: Mhm—yeah, that’s the scary part, because you never even get a chance to help them. Mind if I do a super quick 30‑second calculation on what those missed after-hours calls could be costing you?
User: Sure, go ahead. I estimate about half of those voicemails would book appointments if answered.
Agent: Got it — and what’s your average value per booked appointment, roughly, in dollars?
User: Our average appointment value is around $650.
Agent: Got it — if you booked even 50% of those 20 after-hours missed calls at about $650 each, that’s about **$6500 extra a week**… and that’s roughly **$28100/mo** over a month. Does that feel about right?
User: Yes, that sounds about right. Capturing those calls could really boost our monthly revenue significantly.
Agent: Totally — and that’s exactly what Dialux is built to recover when your team can’t get to the phone. It’s a 20-minute walkthrough—what’s better for you, later today or tomorrow?
User: Tomorrow works best for me. Can you offer some afternoon slots for the live call?
Agent: Absolutely — before I offer times, what time zone are you in: Eastern, Central, Mountain, or Pacific?
User: I'm in the Central time zone, America/Chicago.
Agent: Perfect — Central time. What’s your first name?
User: Maria Gonzales.
Agent: Got it, Maria — what’s the name of your practice?
User: It's Bright Smile Dental in Chicago.
Agent: Perfect, thanks — and is the number you’re calling from the best contact number to reach you?
User: Yes, my best contact number is +13125551234.
Agent: Perfect. So I have Maria Gonzales with Bright Smile Dental, a contact number on file, and Central time— is that all correct?
User: Yes, that's correct. Let's book the live call for tomorrow. What time slots are available in the afternoon?
Agent: Yep — for tomorrow afternoon (Central), I can do **1:00 PM** or **2:30 PM**. Which works?
User: Let's go with 2:30 PM Central. Yes, that's perfect — please book it for the live call.
Agent: So that’s **tomorrow (Thu, Aug 27) at 2:30 PM Central**, correct?
User: Yes, that's perfect — please book it. Looking forward to the live call.
Agent: One moment while I confirm that.
Agent: Thanks, Maria — you’re booked for **tomorrow (Thu, Aug 27) at 2:30 PM Central** with Jay, and you’ll receive an SMS text with the confirmation details so you can add it to your calendar or reschedule if you need to.  

Is there anything else I can help you with?
User: Sure, take your time. I'm looking forward to getting this set up.
Agent: Appreciate it, Maria — really glad you called. Jay’s looking forward to it, and you’ll see that SMS confirmation come through shortly. Have a great rest of your day. Bye!
